_meta.note: Shaped fixture, NOT an HTTP recording and NOT live: values come from read-only SELECT on the local synthetic DB (agentforge-week1-mysql-1, 2026-09-25); structure follows FhirPatientService::parseOpenEMRRecord() and RestControllerHelper::handleProcessingResult() at legacy-baseline 3ccfe1d. Other patient_data columns are omitted. Replace with recorded responses via `npm run test:integration -- --record` once a local token exists. Issue-card routes (rest.allergy.list, rest.problem.list, rest.medication.list) added 2026-09-25 for slices 01-02-01..03 (each slice adds its own route key): values from read-only SELECT on lists/patient_data/list_options (local DB); structure follows AllergyIntoleranceService::search(), ConditionService::search() (rows listed newest-id-first because that query has no ORDER BY, so the port's begdate sort is exercised rather than assumed; diagnosis/provider columns omitted) and ListService::getAll() via RestControllerHelper::responseHandler() (a bare array, or HTTP 404 with an empty body when there are no rows). Prescriptions (rest.prescription.search, slice 01-03-01): values from read-only SELECT on prescriptions/list_options (local DB, 2026-09-25); structure follows PrescriptionService::getBaseSql() (prescriptions branch only: the BFF sends source_table=prescriptions) inside createProcessingResultResponse() (HTTP 200, `data: []` when there are no rows). The outer SELECT has no patient_id/pid column; rows are listed id-ascending because the query has no ORDER BY, so the port's sort is exercised rather than assumed; med-adherence/reporting-source columns omitted. Care Team (fhir.careteam.search, fhir.practitioner.read:<id>, fhir.organization.read:<id>; slice 01-04-01): values from read-only SELECT on care_teams/care_team_member/users/facility/list_options (local DB, 2026-09-25); structure follows FhirCareTeamService::parseOpenEMRRecord() and populateProviderTeamMembers()/populateFacilityTeamMembers() (one Practitioner participant per member row, whatever its status, then one Organization participant per distinct member facility; role display = care_team_roles title for codes outside getRoleMappings(); no participant status or note) in a FhirCareTeamRestController::getAll() Bundle (no paging). The Practitioner reads are 404 with body [] because PractitionerService::search() serves only users with a non-empty NPI and no seeded care-team user has one (handleFhirProcessingResult()); the facility Organization read is 200. Vitals (rest.encounter.list, rest.vital.list:<eid>; slice 01-05-01): values from read-only SELECT on form_encounter/form_vitals/forms/users (local DB, 2026-09-25). rest.encounter.list follows EncounterService::search() (ORDER BY fe.eid DESC; eid = form_encounter.encounter; most columns omitted) in the REST envelope; a patient with no encounters gets HTTP 200 with data [] on the wire, because ViewRendererListener wraps the controller's array in a 200 JsonResponse (API-ROUTES.md Finding 3). rest.vital.list:<eid> follows VitalsService::getVitalsForPatientEncounter() (deleted=0 AND formdir='vitals', so a soft-deleted set is never in it) and createResultRecordFromDatabaseResult() with units_of_measurement=1 (US identity, one <field>_unit key per measurement), written as a bare array by responseHandler(); only the encounters a test needs are included.
